trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Zero-dimensional parameter generated by weight_norm(module, dim=None)
trigger_condition.state_trigger: Model is wrapped with torch.nn.DataParallel after zero-dimensional parameter creation
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Forward and backward execution on multiple CUDA devices
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Use torch.nn.utils.weight_norm(module, dim=None) to produce a 0-dim weight_g parameter, then wrap with torch.nn.DataParallel and run forward/backward on multiple CUDA devices.

bug_oracle.description: Use torch.nn.utils.weight_norm(module, dim=None), which produces a 0-dim weight_g parameter, then wrap the model with torch.nn.DataParallel and run forward/backward on multiple CUDA devices.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate modules with weight_norm applied using dim=None to create zero-dimensional parameters; vary parameter shape boundaries.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct small parameterized modules such as linear or conv layers wrapped with torch.nn.utils.weight_norm(dim=None).
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Require multiple CUDA devices and wrap the module with torch.nn.DataParallel.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Apply weight_norm(dim=None) to a module, wrap with DataParallel, move to CUDA, run forward and backward.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Treat any exception during DataParallel replication or forward/backward as a potential bug; compare with single-device behavior when possible.
